message: frm_curve(): `object` must be a frmtmb fit, the model a curve is read off, not an object of class data.frame
`newdata` must be a data frame with at least one row: it is the grid the curve is evaluated on
`level` must be one number strictly between 0 and 1
frm_curve(simultaneous = TRUE) needs a grid of at least two points: a band over one point is the pointwise interval
`nsim` must be a single whole number of at least 1
